data.description: Where Championship Golf Meets Elite Villa Living

data.answer: Emirates Golf Estate is a gated villa community set within the iconic Emirates Golf Course. It offers residents a blend of luxury, exclusivity, and convenience. The community enjoys a strategic location off Sheikh Zayed Road, with easy access to metro stations, top-tier schools, shopping malls, and entertainment venues. With 24/7 security and a family-friendly atmosphere, it caters to professionals, expats, and golf enthusiasts who value peace without compromising on lifestyle.

The real estate offering within Emirates Golf Club is boutique yet luxurious. It comprises just 84 four-bedroom duplex villas, all available solely for rent. These villas are spacious, modern, and beautifully designed, featuring private gardens, swimming pools, and high-quality finishes. Each villa overlooks the scenic golf course, providing a serene and prestigious backdrop to everyday living. Access to club amenities such as the golf course, tennis and squash courts, and wellness facilities requires a nominal membership fee.

Popular Buildings in Emirates Golf Club

Unlike high-rise-centric communities, Emirates Golf Estate is composed entirely of villa residences. The villas themselves are the primary dwellings and are distinguished by their uniform quality, elegant architecture, and integration with the landscape of the Emirates Golf Course.

Off-Plan Projects in Emirates Golf Club

At this time, there are no off-plan developments within the Emirates Golf Club itself due to its limited and highly exclusive inventory. However, nearby neighborhoods such as Emirates Hills and The Greens often have new residential projects that appeal to the same luxury-oriented demographic.

Renting a Property in Emirates Golf Club

Renting a property in Emirates Golf Club Dubai comes with a premium price tag, reflecting its exclusivity and luxurious lifestyle. 

The average rental rate in the community is approximately AED 265 per sq. ft., and with most villas spanning around 4,000 sq. ft., annual rents typically amount to about AED 1.06M, or roughly AED 88k per month. These spacious 4-bedroom duplex villas include private gardens, swimming pools, and access to world-class golfing amenities although use of facilities like the golf course, tennis, and squash courts requires a separate membership fee.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Emirates Golf Club, Dubai?

data.answer:
Life inside Emirates Golf Estate is calm, lush, and sophisticated. Residents enjoy a resort-style existence, early morning tee times, spa visits, gourmet dining at Carine Emirates Golf Club, and weekend events like the Dubai Desert Classic. 

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Emirates Golf Club

Each villa includes dedicated parking. For visitors, paid parking is available within and around the club, including near Nakheel Metro Station. Residents primarily use private vehicles, though the area is also well-connected via metro, bus, and taxi services. Uber, Careem, and the RTA app provide reliable transport options for residents and guests.

Supermarkets in and Around Emirates Golf Club

Residents have easy access to multiple supermarkets in Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), just 10 minutes away. These include Choithrams, Spinneys, West Zone Fresh Market, and two branches of Carrefour. The Greens Village Centre also houses grocery stores for quick errands.

Shopping Mall Near Emirates Golf Club

Popular shopping destinations like Dubai Marina Mall and Mall of the Emirates are a short drive away. Both offer retail therapy, entertainment, and dining. For everyday essentials, The Greens Village Mall and Trident Grand Mall in Dubai Marina serve the community well.

Schools and Nurseries Near Emirates Golf Club

Families will find top-tier educational institutions nearby. Nurseries include Dewdrops Nursery JLT and Jebel Ali Village Nursery. Notable schools include Dubai International Academy (IB curriculum), Regent International School (British curriculum), and Emirates International School Meadows. 
Universities like American University in Dubai and institutions in Knowledge Park are under 10 minutes away.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Emirates Golf Club

For spiritual needs, residents can visit Greens Mosque or the prayer room within the golf course. Church of Dreams and Fellowship Church in Barsha Heights cater to the Christian community. Temples such as Shiva and Krishna temples in Bur Dubai and the Sikh Gurudwara are accessible within 20–25 minutes.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Emirates Golf Club

Quality healthcare is nearby with Al Zahra Hospital and Saudi German Hospital in Al Barsha. Specialty clinics like Mediclinic Meadows, American Hospital Clinic Dubai Media City, and MediCentres, Greens are also within close range.

Location & Nearby Areas

Emirates Golf Club enjoys a prime central location in Dubai, offering residents quick access to key parts of the city. It is just 8 minutes from Mall of the Emirates, 10 minutes from Dubai Marina, and approximately 17 minutes from Downtown Dubai via Sheikh Zayed Road. 

Surrounded by some of the city’s most prestigious neighborhoods including Emirates Hills, The Greens, The Views, and Barsha Heights, the community is ideally positioned for both convenience and luxury living.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Emirates Golf Club

data.answer:
From golfing on the Majlis and Faldo courses to watching international tournaments, the club offers a variety of leisure options.

Restaurants

Carine Emirates Golf Club is a standout restaurant offering French Mediterranean cuisine. Other on-site options include Jones The Grocer, Spike Bar, and Poolside. Nearby in The Greens, try Lah Lah, Wagamama, or Organic Foods and Café for a diverse culinary experience.

Beaches Near Emirates Golf Club

The nearest beach is JBR Beach, offering sun, sand, and water sports just a short drive away. It’s perfect for weekend outings with family or friends.

Hotels Around Emirates Golf Club

Luxury hotels near the area include The Address Montgomerie, Grosvenor House, and Zabeel House by Jumeirah. These are ideal for visitors or staycations and offer exceptional dining and wellness services.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Fitness enthusiasts can access nearby gyms such as Elevation Fitness, Snap Fitness, and Fitness Zone in JLT. Spas like Tips and Toes in The Greens Village and salons across Barsha Heights and JLT offer beauty and wellness treatments.

Community Events

Emirates Golf Club hosts several international golf tournaments such as the Dubai Desert Classic, Omega Dubai Ladies Classic, and Ladies European Tour Event. These attract global crowds and enhance the community’s vibrant atmosphere.

Attractions and Landmarks

Besides its legendary golf course, the community is close to Jebel Ali Racecourse, Dubai Marina Walk, and Mall of the Emirates. The beautifully landscaped club itself is a Dubai landmark, steeped in history and prestige.

Living in Emirates Golf Club Dubai is a premium experience, best suited for those seeking a lavish, golf-centric lifestyle. Rental prices are higher than average, and villa availability is limited due to the exclusivity of the estate.

more_info.question: FAQs About Emirates Golf Club, Dubai

data.answer:
Is Emirates Golf Club a freehold area?

No, all villas are only available for rent.

Are pets allowed in Emirates Golf Club villas?

Yes, pets are generally allowed, subject to landlord approval.

Can non-golfers live in Emirates Golf Club?

Absolutely. While golf is a major attraction, many residents choose the area for its privacy and luxury.

Is public transport accessible?

Yes, Nakheel Metro Station and several bus stops are within walking distance.
Take a look at the Emirates Golf Club community and its surrounding areas.

data.content:
Tucked between the glimmering skyline of Dubai Marina and the serene Emirates Hills, Emirates Golf Club stands as a crown jewel in Dubai’s luxury residential and sporting landscape. Renowned globally for its lush fairways and high-profile tournaments, the community is more than just a golfer’s paradise; it is an exclusive enclave offering a refined, resort-style lifestyle. 

This Emirates Golf Club Area Guide gives you a comprehensive look at what makes this prestigious neighbourhood one of the most coveted addresses in Dubai. The Emirates Golf Course, opened in 1988, holds the title of being Dubai’s first all-grass championship golf course. 

Home to the internationally acclaimed Dubai Desert Classic and Omega Dubai Ladies Classic, it has twice been ranked among the world’s top 100 golf courses by Golf World Magazine. Beyond the green, the community boasts just 84 exclusive four-bedroom villas, offering residents privacy, opulence, and sweeping views of immaculately maintained fairways.
